response.sql: SELECT 1.0 * COUNT(*) / COUNT(DISTINCT SupportRepId) AS avg_customers_per_support_rep FROM Customer WHERE SupportRepId IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: A support rep is any employee who is assigned as Customer.SupportRepId for at least one customer, so the average is total assigned customers divided by the number of distinct assigned reps. Employees with no assigned customers are excluded from the denominator.
The result is not rounded, and 1.0 is used so the division is not truncated to an integer.

alternatives.interpretation: A support rep is any employee whose Title is 'Sales Support Agent', so the average divides all assigned customers by the count of employees with that title, including any with no customers.
alternatives.sql: SELECT 1.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE SupportRepId IS NOT NULL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent') AS avg_customers_per_support_rep;
